title: QAI Scenario
description: Describes a user intention, independently of the platform. Never contains a selector, a technical identifier, or a coordinate: those live in the resolution file.

id.description: Stable identifier of the scenario. Must never change once assigned.

title.description: What the scenario proves, phrased from the user's point of view.

tags.description: Used for filtering in CI (e.g. critical-path for the blocking pull request batch).

platforms.description: Targeted platforms. Absent = all those configured for the project.

given.description: Required starting state. Declared, never built click by click.

fixtures.description: Named data sets, defined outside the scenario and resolved per environment.

intent.description: An intention for one platform. Never empty: an empty intent would silently turn the step into a verification-only one on that platform.

step.description: A step acts (do or per_platform), verifies (expect or capture), or both. A step without an intent only verifies the screen left by the previous one.

id.description: Stable anchor the cached resolution attaches to. Assigned at creation, never modified — even if the step's text is reworded.

do.description: The intention, in natural language, in the team's language. No selectors. Omit it for a verification-only step; never leave it empty.

per_platform.description: Rewording of the intention for a given platform, when the gesture genuinely differs. An exception to keep rare and visible. Do NOT rename to 'on': YAML 1.1 interprets that key as the boolean true.

only.description: Restricts the step to certain platforms (e.g. a hover does not exist on mobile).

expect.description: Semantic assertion(s). Self-healing is never allowed to modify them.

capture.description: Extracts values from the screen, reusable later via {{name}}. Avoids freezing test data into assertions.
